notes: Current user selection resolves the twelve-section cohort, animal assignments, completed-versus-interrupted export policy and applicable unchanged fixed transformations; these are no longer listed as unknown.

Raw source files are the thirteen newly supplied CSVs in the new project entire Chat dataset folder. Twelve completed exports are primary; interrupted4978 is excluded in favor of5403. Initial eight-file audit remains separate.
The same six animals occur in both arms, with distinct physical sections. Arms are processed separately and are not independent biological replications.
Coordinate units are recorded HALO export units with unverified physical calibration. Area-column micrometer labels do not establish x/y calibration.
Independent per-arm 21F/cavity reference frames are preserved. Shared numeric grid boundaries do not assert cross-arm anatomical correspondence.
Historical proposal/unreviewed annotations are preserved as provenance. The current user/PDF directs fixed reuse; no transforms are refit and no anatomy is self-approved.
Mask assets and centroid definitions remain deliberately unresolved. Internal cavity polygons and detection-occupancy support must not become tissue masks.
Asset paths resolve relative to this manifest directory unless absolute. Do not publish raw sources or push changes without user request.

pending_inputs.required: Existing tissue-boundary polygons including holes, or raster masks with full cell coordinate geometry, matched to section IDs; native/aligned frame and export-unit mapping documented.
pending_inputs.why: Strict 100% full-bin inclusion and condition-specific valid-section N cannot be determined from detection occupancy.

pending_inputs.required: Measured centroid coordinates linked to each source object, or an explicit applicable scientific amendment accepting the recorded bounding-box midpoint proxy.
pending_inputs.why: Current raw files contain bounding-box edges but no measured centroid columns. No proxy is silently approved or used.
